zele.label: Gmail
zele.summary: Read and send Gmail from your own account.
zele.description: Gmail (multi-account, OAuth login): inbox, search, send, reply, contacts. Google Calendar via `zele cal`: list/create/update/delete events (Meet links, recurrence), respond to invites, free/busy.

zele-calendar.label: Google Calendar
zele-calendar.summary: See your Google Calendar and book, move or cancel events.
zele-calendar.description: Google Calendar via `zele cal`: list calendars and events, create/update/delete events with Google Meet links, recurrence and reminders, respond to invites, free/busy.

xurl.label: X
xurl.summary: Post to X and read timelines, replies and DMs.

linkedin-api.label: LinkedIn
linkedin-api.summary: Read LinkedIn profiles and send messages and connection requests.
linkedin-api.description: LinkedIn Voyager API CLI for profiles, conversations, DMs, and connections.

figma-api.label: Figma
figma-api.summary: Read Figma files, export images and leave comments.
figma-api.description: Figma REST API CLI. File commands take a file key or Figma URL. Canvas writes (frames/text/shapes) use `figma-api run` via the plugin bridge. Run `figma-api <cmd> --help` for params.

slack-cli.label: Slack
slack-cli.summary: Work with Slack workspaces and apps.
slack-cli.statusCmd: slack-cli auth list 2>&1 | grep 'Team' >/dev/null && echo authenticated
slack-cli.description: Invoked as `slack-cli` to avoid colliding with the Slack desktop app’s `slack` binary.

telegram-send.label: Telegram
telegram-send.summary: Send Telegram messages, photos and files.
telegram-send.description: Send messages, send files & images, send video & audio, Markdown/HTML formatting, channel & group support

meta-ads.label: Meta Ads
meta-ads.summary: Run Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns and see how they perform.
meta-ads.statusCmd: out=$(meta auth status 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -m1 .; exit $rc
meta-ads.description: Meta/Facebook & Instagram ad campaigns: campaigns/adsets/ads CRUD, insights & reporting, catalog/product-feed/product-set/product-item, ad creatives, datasets (pixels), pages — Marketing API via the official `meta` CLI. No raw/passthrough mode; for arbitrary Graph API calls with a Page token use `facebook-pages-api request <method> <path>`.

elevenlabs-api.label: ElevenLabs
elevenlabs-api.summary: Turn text into natural speech, in many voices and languages.
elevenlabs-api.statusCmd: test -f ~/.config/todoforai/elevenlabs.json && echo authenticated || test -n "$ELEVENLABS_API_KEY" && echo authenticated

ffmpeg.label: FFmpeg
ffmpeg.summary: Convert, trim and resize video and audio files.
ffmpeg.description: Media swiss-army knife: `ffmpeg -i in.mp4 out.webm`; `ffprobe` for metadata.

tfa-imagegen.label: Image Gen
tfa-imagegen.summary: Generate and edit images from a description.
tfa-imagegen.description: AI image generation & editing via TODOFORAI backend (gpt-image, nano-banana, nano-banana-pro, mai-image-2.6)

suno-api.label: Suno
suno-api.summary: Generate music and songs from a prompt.
suno-api.description: AI music generation, custom lyrics, multiple genres.

ntn.label: Notion
ntn.summary: Read and update Notion pages and databases.
ntn.description: Official Notion CLI: raw API calls (`ntn api <path>`), page/data-source management, file uploads, Workers deploy.

perplexity-api.label: Perplexity
perplexity-api.summary: Ask questions and get answers researched from the web.
perplexity-api.statusCmd: test -f ~/.config/todoforai/perplexity.json && echo authenticated || test -n "$PERPLEXITY_API_KEY" && echo authenticated
perplexity-api.description: AI-powered web search, chat completions, async chat, embeddings and agent runs

gh.label: GitHub
gh.summary: Work with your GitHub repos, pull requests and issues.
gh.statusCmd: gh auth status 2>&1 | grep 'Logged in to' | grep -m1 .
gh.description: Prefer `gh` over raw GitHub API calls.

mcporter.label: MCP (mcporter)
mcporter.summary: Use tools from any MCP server.
mcporter.statusCmd: mcporter list 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'No MCP servers' | grep -m1 .
mcporter.description: MCP servers as CLI: `mcporter list [server] [--schema]`, `mcporter call <server>.<tool> key=value` (`key=@file`), `mcporter config add <name> <cmd-or-url>`, `mcporter auth <server>`. `--help` for more.

glab.label: GitLab
glab.summary: Work with your GitLab repos, merge requests and pipelines.
glab.statusCmd: glab auth status 2>&1 | grep 'Logged in to' | grep -m1 .

vercel.label: Vercel
vercel.summary: Deploy websites to Vercel and manage them.
vercel.description: `vercel deploy`; manage env vars, domains, preview URLs.

netlify.label: Netlify
netlify.summary: Deploy websites to Netlify and manage them.
netlify.description: `netlify deploy --prod` for production; manage env vars, forms, identity.

firebase.label: Firebase
firebase.summary: Deploy and manage Firebase hosting, database and functions.
firebase.description: Deploy hosting/functions, manage Firestore/RTDB rules and data, auth users, emulators.

wrangler.label: Cloudflare
wrangler.summary: Deploy and manage Cloudflare Workers and Pages.
wrangler.description: Tail logs with `wrangler tail`. Use `cloudflared` for tunnels.

stripe.label: Stripe
stripe.summary: Look up Stripe payments, customers and subscriptions.
stripe.description: `stripe listen` forwards webhooks locally; `stripe get/post /v1/...` for raw API.

flyctl.label: Fly.io
flyctl.summary: Deploy and scale apps on Fly.io.
flyctl.description: `flyctl deploy` from app dir; manage Postgres/volumes/machines/secrets.

supabase.label: Supabase
supabase.summary: Manage your Supabase database, auth and storage.
supabase.description: Link to cloud project; runs/migrates local Postgres.

railway.label: Railway
railway.summary: Deploy and manage apps and databases on Railway.
railway.statusCmd: out=$(RAILWAY_NO_TELEMETRY=1 railway whoami 2>&1); rc=$?; printf '%s\n' "$out" | grep -m1 .; exit $rc

shopify.label: Shopify
shopify.summary: Build and manage Shopify stores and themes.
shopify.description: Theme development, app scaffolding, store management

shop-app.label: Shop
shop-app.summary: Search products and compare prices across Shopify stores.
shop-app.description: Shop.app product search across Shopify stores. `shop-app search '<query>' --ships-to HU -n 10` returns products with price, rating, URL, and variants. `shop-app similar <variantId>` finds lookalikes.

datadog-ci.label: Datadog
datadog-ci.summary: Send test results and releases to Datadog.
datadog-ci.description: CI test visibility, sourcemap uploads, deployment tracking.

sentry-cli.label: Sentry
sentry-cli.summary: Manage Sentry releases and error tracking.

tfa-cli.label: TODOforAI
tfa-cli.summary: Create and follow up on your TODOs, and show results in the chat.
tfa-cli.description: Manage the user's OWN TODOforAI tasks (not code `// TODO` comments). Delegate/spin off work: `tfa-cli "prompt"` creates a real TODO with its own agent and chat (`-n` wait for completion, `--no-watch` fire-and-forget, `--project/--agent/--model`, `--resume <id>`, `addmessage <id> "text"`). Inspect: `list [--status open]`, `--inspect <id>`. Surface results into chat: `show <file|-> [todo-id]` (renders by mimetype; `--card <name>` via project renderer; `--alias <name>` updates in place), `open <url>` embeds a live preview. `--template` for registry workflows.

curl.label: Web Request
curl.summary: Fetch URLs and call web APIs.
curl.description: HTTP/HTTPS/FTP client: GET/POST/PUT/DELETE, headers, auth, file upload/download, follow redirects, cookies, TLS.

cloudflared.label: Tunnel
cloudflared.summary: Put a local app on a public web address.
cloudflared.description: `cloudflared tunnel --url http://localhost:<port>` prints a public https URL.

vault.label: HashiCorp Vault
vault.summary: Read and manage secrets in HashiCorp Vault.
vault.description: HashiCorp Vault secrets management and dynamic credentials.

rclone.label: Cloud Storage
rclone.summary: Move files between Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive, S3 and more.
rclone.statusCmd: rclone listremotes --long 2>/dev/null | tr -s ' ' | grep -v ' todoforai$' | grep -m20 .

gdrive.label: Google Drive
gdrive.userInfoCmd: TOKEN=$(rclone config dump 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.loads(json.load(sys.stdin)['{{REMOTE}}']['token'])['access_token'])") && curl -sf 'https://www.googleapis.com/drive/v3/about?fields=user' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['user']['emailAddress'])" 2>/dev/null

onedrive.label: OneDrive
onedrive.userInfoCmd: TOKEN=$(rclone config dump 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.loads(json.load(sys.stdin)['{{REMOTE}}']['token'])['access_token'])") && curl -sf 'https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/me' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('mail') or d.get('userPrincipalName',''))" 2>/dev/null

dropbox.label: Dropbox
dropbox.userInfoCmd: TOKEN=$(rclone config dump 2>/dev/null | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.loads(json.load(sys.stdin)['{{REMOTE}}']['token'])['access_token'])") && curl -sf -X POST 'https://api.dropboxapi.com/2/users/get_current_account' -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" | python3 -c "import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)['email'])" 2>/dev/null

rclone.description: Access Google Drive, OneDrive, Dropbox, S3, and 40+ cloud providers. List, copy, sync, move, and mount files; use `rclone config create <name> <provider>` to connect.

aws.label: AWS
aws.summary: Manage your AWS account and services.
aws.statusCmd: aws sts get-caller-identity --query Arn --output text 2>/dev/null | sed 's/.*\///' | grep -m1 .
aws.description: Official AWS CLI v2. Auth via `aws configure` (access keys) or `aws configure sso` + `aws sso login` (browser device flow).
aws.uninstallCmd: sudo -n rm -rf /usr/local/aws-cli /usr/local/bin/aws /usr/local/bin/aws_completer 2>/dev/null || { echo "aws was installed with sudo; remove it manually: sudo rm -rf /usr/local/aws-cli /usr/local/bin/aws /usr/local/bin/aws_completer"; exit 1; }

gcloud.label: Google Cloud
gcloud.summary: Manage your Google Cloud projects and services.
gcloud.description: Official Google Cloud CLI. `gcloud auth login --no-launch-browser` prints the OAuth URL and waits for the pasted verification code.
gcloud.uninstallCmd: rm -rf "$HOME/google-cloud-sdk" && ! command -v gcloud >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "gcloud is still on PATH: $(command -v gcloud)"; exit 1; }

az.label: Azure
az.statusCmd: az account show --query user.name -o tsv 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | grep -m1 .
az.description: Official Azure CLI. Device-code login: prints login.microsoft.com/device + a code, then polls — no callback port.

doctl.label: DigitalOcean
doctl.summary: Manage your DigitalOcean servers and apps.
doctl.statusCmd: doctl account get --format Email --no-header 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\r' | grep -m1 .
doctl.description: Official DigitalOcean CLI. `doctl auth init` prompts for an API token from cloud.digitalocean.com/account/api/tokens.

rdt.label: Reddit
rdt.summary: Search Reddit, read threads and post comments.
rdt.description: Reddit CLI. Read: `rdt search "<query>" -r <sub> --json -c`, `rdt sub <name>`, `rdt read <postId>`, `rdt user-comments <user>`. Write: `rdt comment <postId> "<text>"`, `rdt upvote`, `rdt save`.

pymupdf.label: PDF
pymupdf.summary: Read, edit, merge and split PDF files.
pymupdf.versionCmd: { python -c 'import pymupdf; print(pymupdf.__version__)' || python3 -c 'import pymupdf; print(pymupdf.__version__)' || py -c 'import pymupdf; print(pymupdf.__version__)'; } 2>/dev/null
pymupdf.description: PDF text editing, extraction, merge, split. Call via `python3 -c`.

anydoc.label: Doc to Markdown
anydoc.summary: Turn Word, PowerPoint, Excel and other documents into clean text.
anydoc.description: Office/rich docs (docx/pptx/xlsx/odt/rtf/epub/csv) → Markdown, fully local. `anydoc file.docx` → stdout, `-o out.md` writes, `anydoc - --format csv < stdin`. Prefer over raw XML extraction for reading; one-way, no OCR for scanned PDFs.

agent-browser.label: Browser
agent-browser.summary: Browse websites automatically: click, type, read and screenshot.
agent-browser.description: Browser automation over CDP (`open`/`snapshot`/`click`/`type`/`fill`/`read`/`screenshot`/`eval`). `connect '<url>'` to a listed live browser (prefer the user's real Chrome), verify with `snapshot`; if empty, `close` (own session only) and reconnect once. NEVER `close --all`. Shared browser: `tab new` for your own tab, `tab <id>` before each command. No URL listed: cloud → browser-manager-cli; PC with display → Chrome `--remote-debugging-port=9222`, attach `--cdp 9222`.

browser-manager-cli.label: Browser Manager
browser-manager-cli.summary: Start browsers in the cloud for automated browsing.
browser-manager-cli.description: Spawns cloud Chromium sessions, each exposed as a CDP WebSocket for agent-browser to drive. `create` prints one line ending in a cdpUrl — pass it straight to `agent-browser connect '<cdpUrl>'` (connect the cdpUrl, not the Chrome debug port). `list`/`get <id>`, `delete <id>`/`delete-all`, `hibernate`/`restore`. Sessions run stealth Chromium that reads as a real desktop browser. For sites that block datacenter IPs, route through a proxy: `create --proxy socks5://host:port [--proxy-user U --proxy-pass P]`. Use this on the cloud VM instead of launching a local browser.

todoforai-browser.label: Browser (Extension)
todoforai-browser.summary: Drive your own browser through the TODOforAI extension.
todoforai-browser.description: Browser automation via extension (non-headless), web scraping, accessibility tree snapshots, screenshots, PDF generation

tfa-explore.label: Explore
tfa-explore.summary: Send a helper agent to explore a codebase and report back.
tfa-explore.description: Explore a codebase in a sub-agent (its reads/greps never touch your context; you get only the answer): `tfa-explore "where is auth handled?"` — read-only, `--repo <path>` (default cwd). Prefer over manual multi-file searching for any non-trivial where/how/what question.

tfa-review.label: Review
tfa-review.summary: Send a helper agent to review your code changes.
tfa-review.description: Review a git diff in a sub-agent (costs none of your context): `tfa-review "<goal>"` — `--repo <path>`, `--against <ref>` (default uncommitted). Streams issues and simplifications. Run before calling a non-trivial change done.

tfa-summary.label: Summary
tfa-summary.summary: Summarize files or long output with a helper agent.
tfa-summary.description: Summarize long input in a sub-agent so raw text never enters your context: `cat big.log | tfa-summary "what failed?"` or `tfa-summary -f a.md -f b.md "focus"` (last bare arg = focus).

tfa-handoff.label: Handoff
tfa-handoff.summary: Turn a long conversation into a short handover note.
tfa-handoff.description: Compact a conversation into a handoff document for a fresh agent.

tfa-wait.label: Wait
tfa-wait.summary: Wait for a time or an event, then continue the task.
tfa-wait.description: Schedule wake-ups and wait for events — time (`3h`, `daily@9:00`), webhooks, or a command's output; results return into the conversation. Wait for a long job: `tfa-wait 'bench || 6h' "Done: exit {{payload.exit}}"` then `tfa-wait run '<cmd>' --pipe bench --on-exit &` (each stdout line = event; cancelling kills the command). Never pgrep/sleep poll loops.

tfa-vault.label: Vault
tfa-vault.description: The user's encrypted secret vault — using its secrets is the intended workflow. READ: when a task needs a key/token/password the user owns, `tfa-vault list` then `get <path>`; don't ask for what's already stored; never echo values. WRITE proactively: any new secret in the conversation (pasted, generated, from a login) → `put <path> field=value` (check `get` first; `patch` adds fields; overwrite on rotation). Paths: `accounts/<svc>`, `api/<svc>`, `secrets/<name>`.

tfa-memory.label: Memory
tfa-memory.summary: Your long-term memory of notes, facts and past TODOs.
tfa-memory.description: User's long-term memory (notes/procedures/decisions, address `source/ref`) plus every past TODO message (read-only, `todo/<todoId>:<messageId>`). READ: `search "<topic>" --mode fused` first (`lexical` = all words newest first, `semantic` = meaning; `--source todo` / `--todo <id>` narrow). stderr prints `N row(s) contain a query word` — if N exceeds what you saw, page with `--exclude <address>`. `get <address>` = full row, `around <address> --before N --after N` = surrounding dialogue. Before answering from memory, search once more with your draft's key facts. WRITE durable facts proactively: `add <source>/<ref> "text"` (same address updates in place; short source names like deploy-notes, preferences). `sources` lists them.

todoregistry-cli.label: TODO Registry
todoregistry-cli.description: Reusable business task templates (SEO, email, CRM, ads, social, …): `search <q>`, `get <id>`, `list [category]`, `categories`, `create --name … --description … --body @prompt.md`. To recommend a template, don't create a todo directly — `tfa-cli recommend --template <id> --project <projectId>`.

tfa-surface.label: Surface
tfa-surface.summary: See and control what is on your TODOforAI screen.
tfa-surface.description: The user's live UI from the shell. `describe` shows what's open (todos, panels, focus, embedded-browser CDP URL; `--json`). `panel open changes|preview|browser|terminal [--url]`, `todo open|focus|close <id>`. Persistent state (plans, reports, live status) → `show chat.panel <todoId> "...md"` (stdin ok; re-show updates in place), `clear` removes; events go in chat. `card add|list|get|rm <name>` = project HTML renderers. Exit 2 = no frontend connected.

bun.label: JS/TS Runtime
bun.summary: Run JavaScript and TypeScript code, fast.
bun.cloudInstallCmd: export BUN_INSTALL=/usr/local && curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash && ln -sf /usr/local/bin/bun /usr/local/bin/bunx
bun.description: Run JavaScript/TypeScript, install packages, run tests (`bun`, `bunx`).

bunx.label: Bun Package Runner
bunx.summary: Run a JavaScript package without installing it.

npm.label: Node Package Manager
npm.description: Install Node packages and run package scripts.

npx.label: Node Package Runner
npx.summary: Run a JavaScript package without installing it.

uv.label: Python Package Manager
uv.summary: Install Python packages and manage environments, fast.
uv.description: Manage Python dependencies, environments, tools, and scripts (`uv`, `uvx`).

uvx.label: Python Tool Runner
uvx.summary: Run a Python tool without installing it.
uvx.description: Run Python tools in isolated environments.

ripgrep.label: Search
ripgrep.summary: Search text across files, very fast.
ripgrep.description: Fast recursive grep with regex, .gitignore-aware, parallel, unicode-correct

ast-grep.label: Structural Search
ast-grep.summary: Search and rewrite code by its structure, not just text.
ast-grep.description: Use when regex cannot distinguish syntax from text: `ast-grep -p "foo($$$)" -l ts` finds real calls while ignoring strings and comments; add `--rewrite "..."` for codemods. Prefer `rg` for literal or token search.

fd.label: Find Files
fd.summary: Find files and folders by name.
fd.description: Fast user-friendly find replacement: regex by default, .gitignore-aware, parallel

jq.label: JSON
jq.description: Command-line JSON processor: query, filter, transform, format JSON streams

patch.label: Apply Diff
patch.description: Apply unified/context diff patches to files; reverse, dry-run, fuzzy matching

sed.label: Replace Text
sed.summary: Find and replace text in files.
sed.description: Stream editor: in-place text substitution, line filtering, scripted edits

grep.label: Search Text
grep.description: Search plain text for lines matching a regex: recursive, fixed-string, context, invert, count

wordpress-api.label: WordPress
wordpress-api.summary: Read and publish WordPress posts and pages.
wordpress-api.description: WordPress REST API CLI. `wordpress-api auth --site https://example.com --user <user> --password '<application password>'` (application password, not the login password). Reading published content needs no auth. `posts list|get|create|update|delete`, `pages`, `media`, `categories`. `posts create` saves a draft unless --status publish. On Elementor/JetEngine sites content.rendered comes back empty — fetch the post's public URL for the body.

facebook-pages-api.label: Facebook Pages
facebook-pages-api.summary: Post to your Facebook Page and handle comments.
facebook-pages-api.description: Facebook Pages CLI (Meta Graph API). `auth --page-id <id> --page-token <token>` (or env FB_PAGE_ID/FB_PAGE_TOKEN). `feed`, `comments`, `insights`, `conversations`, `media`, and `request <GET|POST|DELETE> <path> [--data <json>]` = any Graph edge with the page token attached (use instead of curl). Writes are live: `feed create --published false` for tests; `comments reply` posts publicly — get human approval. Follower totals: `whoami --fields followers_count,fan_count` (many classic insights metrics are retired). `--help` for subcommands.

ews-api.label: Exchange (EWS)
ews-api.summary: Read and write mail on a company Exchange server.
ews-api.description: On-prem Microsoft Exchange mail over EWS (cloud/M365 → outlook-api). `auth --email <e> --username 'DOMAIN\\user' --server <host>` (NTLM; password prompt or `--password-stdin`; --server required). Multi-mailbox: `whoami`, `--account <email>`/EWS_ACCOUNT, `default`, `logout`; EWS_EMAIL/EWS_USERNAME/EWS_PASSWORD/EWS_SERVER for unattended runs. `list`, `search <q>`, `read <id>`, `draft`, `reply <id>` — draft/reply stay in Drafts unless --send. Password stored plaintext in ~/.config/ews-api (0600); re-auth after rotation.

outlook-api.label: Outlook (Graph)
outlook-api.summary: Read and write your Outlook mail.
outlook-api.description: Outlook/Hotmail/M365 mail over Microsoft Graph (on-prem Exchange → ews-api). `auth` = device-code flow; `--tenant consumers` (default, personal) | `organizations`. list/search/read/attachments are read-only; `draft`/`reply` stay in Drafts unless --send; `send <draftId>`. `get <path>` = raw Graph GET. JSON out.

neonctl.label: Neon Postgres
neonctl.summary: Manage your Neon Postgres databases and branches.
neonctl.statusCmd: test -f ~/.config/neon/credentials.json && neonctl me --output json 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*"email"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | grep -m10 .
neonctl.description: Manage Neon Postgres branches and run SQL: `neonctl projects list`, `neonctl branches create`, `neonctl connection-string`. Aliased as `neon`.

m365.label: Microsoft 365
m365.summary: Work with Microsoft 365 mail, Teams, SharePoint and users.
m365.statusCmd: m365 status --output text 2>/dev/null | tr -d '"' | grep -vi 'logged out' | grep -m1 .
m365.description: Microsoft 365 from the shell: `m365 outlook message list`, `m365 teams team list`, `m365 spo site list`. Device-code login; add `--output json` for parseable output.

hubspot.label: HubSpot
hubspot.summary: Work with your HubSpot contacts, deals and content.
hubspot.description: Invoked as `hs`. `hs api <endpoint>` makes authenticated calls to any HubSpot API (contacts, deals, companies) — prefer it over raw curl.

posthog-cli.label: PostHog
posthog-cli.summary: Query PostHog product analytics and manage feature flags.
posthog-cli.description: Official PostHog CLI. `posthog-cli api tools` lists the agent-first API tool catalog, `posthog-cli api call <tool> '<json>'` runs one (SQL queries, insights, flags). Also uploads sourcemaps/dSYM. Env alternative: POSTHOG_CLI_API_KEY + POSTHOG_CLI_PROJECT_ID.

canva.label: Canva
canva.description: Official Canva CLI — app-development focused: `canva apps create/list/preview`. `canva mcp` starts the Canva Developer MCP server. For design/export automation use the Canva Connect REST API.

webflow.label: Webflow
webflow.summary: Manage Webflow sites, CMS content and assets.
webflow.description: Manage Webflow sites from the shell: `webflow sites list`, `webflow cms ...`, `webflow assets ...`. Add `--skip-update-check` in scripts.

readwise.label: Readwise
readwise.summary: Search and save articles and highlights in Readwise.
readwise.statusCmd: readwise whoami >/dev/null 2>&1 && readwise whoami 2>/dev/null | sed 's/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m//g' | grep -m1 .
readwise.description: Official Readwise/Reader CLI. `readwise search <query>`, `readwise list`, `readwise save <url>`; supports JSON output for piping and a read-only mode for agents. Token login for CI: `readwise login-with-token <token>` (get one at readwise.io/access_token).

granola.label: Granola
granola.summary: Read your Granola meeting notes and transcripts.
granola.statusCmd: granola auth status -o json 2>/dev/null | sed -n 's/.*"authenticated": *true.*/authenticated/p' | grep -m1 .
granola.description: Community Granola CLI (read-only). `granola meeting list [-l N] [--since <date>] [-s <query>] [-a <attendee>] -o json`, `granola meeting notes|enhanced|transcript <id>`, `granola meeting export <id>`; `granola folder list`, `granola workspace list`. `-o json|yaml|toon` for piping. Login imports credentials from the installed Granola desktop app (`granola auth login`) — desktop app must be logged in on the same machine; transcripts need a paid Granola plan.

trello.label: Trello
trello.summary: Manage your Trello boards, lists and cards.
trello.description: Community Trello CLI (mheap/trello-cli, no official one exists). Auth is a Trello API key + token from https://trello.com/app-key — `trello auth:api-key <key>` then `trello auth:token <token>`. `board:list`, `list:list --board <name>`, `card:list --board <b> --list <l>`, `card:create --board <b> --list <l> --name <n> [--description ..] [--due <date>]`, `card:move`, `card:comment`, `label:*`, `search <q>`. Add `--format json` for piping. Names resolve via a local cache; run `trello board:list` once after login to warm it.

mapps.label: monday.com
mapps.description: Invoked as `mapps` — app development and monday-code deployments only; `mapps init -t <token>` stores a monday.com API token in ~/.mappsrc. To read/write board DATA use the monday.com GraphQL API (api.monday.com/v2) with that same token.

exa-cli.label: Exa Search
exa-cli.summary: Search the web and pull page contents, built for AI.
exa-cli.description: Invoked as `exa`. `exa search <query>`, `exa answer <question>`, `exa contents <url>`, `exa find-similar <url>` — JSON by default. Needs EXA_API_KEY in the environment (get one at dashboard.exa.ai); store it in the vault.

mobbin.label: Mobbin
mobbin.summary: Browse real app and website design examples.
mobbin.statusCmd: mobbin auth print-cookie 2>/dev/null | grep -E '[A-Za-z0-9]' >/dev/null && echo authenticated
mobbin.description: Unofficial CLI over Mobbin's undocumented web endpoints. `mobbin search --query "login" --platform ios`. Auth reuses browser cookies: log into mobbin.com in Chrome, then `mobbin auth save-cookie`.

blender-mcp.label: Blender
blender-mcp.summary: Model, texture and render 3D scenes in a running Blender.
blender-mcp.statusCmd: command -v blender-mcp >/dev/null && mcporter call blender.get_addon_status --output json 2>/dev/null | grep -o '"blender_version": "[^"]*"' | grep -m1 .
blender-mcp.loginCmd: command -v mcporter >/dev/null 2>&1 || bun add -g mcporter; mcporter config add blender --command blender-mcp --env BLENDER_MCP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 --description 'Blender 3D via ahujasid/blender-mcp addon' --scope home
blender-mcp.description: Blender 3D via the ahujasid/blender-mcp server through mcporter: `mcporter list blender --schema`, `mcporter call blender.<tool> key=value` (`code=@file.py`; every tool needs `user_prompt`). Workhorse: execute_blender_code (any bpy Python); also scene/object info, viewport screenshot (`--save-images <dir>`), PolyHaven/Sketchfab import. Needs a GUI Blender with the addon server started (socket :9876; headless has none). 'Could not connect' → `blender-mcp install-addon`, enable in Preferences → Add-ons, N-panel → Start MCP Server (scripted: `blender --python s.py`, s.py registers a `bpy.app.timers` calling `bpy.ops.blendermcp.start_server()`). Code runs unguarded: save first (`bpy.ops.wm.save_mainfile()`), approve destructive ops.
blender-mcp.versionCmd: { python -c 'from importlib.metadata import version; print(version("blender-mcp"))' || python3 -c 'from importlib.metadata import version; print(version("blender-mcp"))'; } 2>/dev/null
